name: copilot-token-tracker
description: Local-first Copilot Chat/Agent usage, token, and cost dashboard

commands.title: Copilot Token Tracker: Sync to Team Now

copilotTokenTracker.export.enabled.description: Send usage metadata to your team's collector. Off by default — nothing leaves this machine unless you turn this on and set an endpoint.

copilotTokenTracker.export.endpoint.description: Your team's ingestion API URL. Required for export to do anything even when enabled.

copilotTokenTracker.export.authHeader.description: Full Authorization header value sent with each export request, e.g. "Bearer <token>". Left empty, no auth header is sent.

copilotTokenTracker.export.orgId.description: A static org/team identifier included on every exported document.

copilotTokenTracker.export.identity.description: "pseudonymous" tags exports with a salted hash of your git email (or OS username as fallback) so per-person trends work without exporting your real identity. "anonymous" sends no user identifier at all.

copilotTokenTracker.export.pseudonymSalt.description: Shared org-wide secret for pseudonymization. Must be the SAME value on every teammate's machine for cross-machine trends to work — ask whoever runs your team's collector for this value. Left empty, each machine falls back to its own random salt (stable per-machine, but the same person looks like a different user on each machine).
